Benchmarks: n=5, same method as `docs/benchmarks/reports/rca-post-rust/evidence/rca-post-rust.json`. Baselines: leetcode-backend 0.63 MB binary, 5.7 ms cold start, 2.5 MB idle RSS (measured 2026-10-09); dependency-cost spike for an axum + reqwest + OTLP service: 4.1 MB binary, 9.8 ms start, 6.6 MB RSS; rca-service as in `rca-post-rust.json`.

- Dev Deploy time (owner instruction 2026-10-09, every service in under five minutes): the pipeline builds the Rust services and the runner's `wf` with a `deploy` profile (no fat LTO) and the capture image copies only the two root postinstall scripts into its dependency stages. A push that changes all four deploy targets took 3 min 17 s end to end (run 37966325120, head `846130f`; 7 min 06 s before the capture change, 14 min 45 s before the profile); a Rust-only push took 4 min 11 s; a cold cache fill costs about 15 min once. After that deploy, `/health` of both services reports `846130f`, and the authenticated probes were run again on those images: the WebSocket handshake 7 of 7 and the leetcode routes 8 of 8, secrets never printed. On the final head (`42b1161`, a lockfile change that rebuilt both service images: 3 min 17 s for that Deploy, `remote-chat-agent` 1 min 43 s and `leetcode-backend` 1 min 7 s) the live `/health` of both services reports `42b1161`, BetterStack returns `server.listening` and heartbeat lines for both, the process table of each image shows one process and no `node`, convert and voice answer 200, the authenticated probes pass again (WebSocket 7 of 7, leetcode routes 8 of 8), and the VNC gate of the `wf` in the `da1ce64` image passes 10 of 10 on aarch64 (the `wf` crate did not change after it). The grep of done-when 1 on the head before that change is in the decision log. Detail there.

- Final checks on head `846130f` (2026-10-09): `cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings` exits 0 in `backend/` and in `clis/`; `cargo test --workspace` passes 229 tests in 18 suites in `backend/` and 138 in 16 in `clis/`, none failed or ignored. The grep over `backend/` and `clis/` for HTTP framing strings, `Sec-WebSocket`, the SHA-1 GUID, `Command::new("curl"|"wget"|"openssl")`, `httparse`, `extern "C"` and hand-set CORS headers finds only test fixtures (the `cdp` test's fake server writes one raw HTTP response). The one production hit of an earlier grep is gone: `wf`'s `app_bench` used to decode the `mappings` field of a source map by hand (the base64-VLQ digits of the source-map format, about 35 lines, `clis/wf/src/app_bench/domain.rs`) and now reads it with the `sourcemap` crate (decoding 25.44 ms to 11.91 ms on a generated 240,000-segment map, binary +65,984 B, twelve small crates added; decision log and `clis-wf.md`). `percent_decode` in `clis/http` is a wrapper over `percent-encoding`.
